display_long_description: Oversense Meeting allows users from all over the world to meet in an elegant virtual room expertly set up with the most useful devices for an efficient meeting: interactive tables, mega displays, large and bright spaces to host 3D objects of any size: from bench exhibitors up to cars, presses, strapping machines…. there are no size limits. Each object can correspond to a suitable environment for its display and sharing. Users participating in the event can move freely around the object and appreciate every detail, also observing the gears and their automations. The interactivity levels achieved allow the avatars to exchange virtual documents, to move quickly with a click to distant points of the virtual room but above all to use a virtual panel for selecting 3D objects, video contributions and images to be displayed on the meeting room displays during the meeting. All contributions are accessible from a cloud repository that allows the upload and management of contributes in total auto
